question: If {x³} + (1)/({{x³)}} = 18, then what will be the value of x + (1)/(x)?
solution:
**Given:**

{x³} + (1)/({{x³)}} = 18

**Concept Used:**

a³ + b³ = (a + b)³ – 3ab(a + b)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Using the formula, we get

⇒ x³+(1)/(x³)=(x+(1)/(x))³-3times xtimes (1)/(x) (x+(1)/(x))

⇒ \(18=\left(x+\frac{1}{x}\right)³-3\left(x+\frac{1}{x}\right)\
